test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

For the past / three years, / my uncle is /away from home.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the present tense "**is**" instead of the present perfect tense "**has been**."
 
• When referring to an action or state that began in the past and continues to the present, the present perfect tense should be used.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**my uncle has been**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"For the past three years, my uncle **has been **away from home."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "three years,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "For the past"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "away from home."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
